mentions.name: ScratchTJ
mentions.description: A DIY digital turntable for scratching and mixing built with a Raspberry Pi and Arduino Nano, based on the open-source SC1000 code with hardware changes and tweaks to make it easier to build and customize. It runs on a Raspberry Pi 2 with an AudioInjector sound card, a small LCD screen, a rotary encoder, and an old hard-drive platter as the deck, aiming to be a simple, open, and affordable way to explore DIY DJ tech and embedded audio.
mentions.problem: Experimenting with scratching and mixing normally requires fancy, expensive gear; ScratchTJ aims to be a simple, open, and affordable alternative.
mentions.audience: Hobbyists who want an affordable way to experiment with scratching and mixing without fancy DJ gear
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on ScratchTJ, a DIY digital turntable built with a Raspberry Pi and Arduino Nano. It’s based on the open-source SC1000 code, but with some hardware changes and tweaks to make it easier to build and customize.
